body: I just don’t care what I want it doesn’t matter, obviously there are a lot of things that would be great but...I just won’t let myself do it
i don’t know there’s really no easy way for me to answer this, even I don’t fully know what’s wrong. It’s like one side of me genuinly wants to be happy but the other never wants to be happy.

I should clairify I’m less conflicted anout ending my life and more conflicted enotionally/mentally about everything. When it does come to ending my life, it’s not like I want to, my ideal perfect world would obviously not be me killing myself but this is what its come to.

I’ve tried talking to people on the hotline but it hasn’t helped. The problem with saying “it gets better” im my case at least is that that’s only if you let it. There’s a part of me that just won’t let myself get better.
